name: 80918 · Colorado Spgs, CO
findings: ZIP 80918 (Colorado Spgs) has 238 nonprofit organizations. 125 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 109 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80918 (Colorado Spgs) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
